P238: shared importer rfb_import.py (PROPFIND via hardened XML, plan with 3x free-space refusal, resumable Range+If-Range downloads into .part files with ETag/size checks, streamed latin-1 ';' rows, batched inserts, indexes after load, atomic 0600 install, superseded dumps deleted; presets full|qsa|names shared with P361 - p2-G10-3 references `--names`, accepted as an alias). 1M-row memory check run once with V3LUM_SLOW=1: passed (84 s, peak < 500 MB). The importer refuses until a maintainer records the official share link + source page + date (FC2: the minha-receita token is never shipped); legal must record the robots.txt reading for the RFB share and in.gov.br (A9, prep H1). P241: one noncommercial source (cnj.datajud) so the licence gate skips the whole module under corporate; the module also refuses when cnj.datajud is outside ctx.allowed_sources. HTTP 429 is RATE_LIMITED 'could not verify: DataJud overloaded' without resend (core P334 backoff); the one retry with backoff applies to failed shards / timed_out in HTTP 200. Key: configured, else the published key read from the official page (in-memory, redacted, ttl 0), one refresh per run on 401. P242: no network at all; the official dump URL could not be recorded (www.in.gov.br drops the connection from the build egress), so dumps downloaded by hand are installed with install_dumps() / python -m ...dou_search install; dump_ok.zip is derived (real titles/organs/pages, synthetic bodies) and must be replaced by a trimmed real excerpt from the team network before merge (backlog FC4/FC9). rfb provider is seeded (not edited); no rfb extension needed. New providers: cnj (api-publica.datajud.cnj.jus.br, datajud-wiki.cnj.jus.br), imprensa_nacional (www.in.gov.br, in.gov.br).
